integrity: The symbolic correction follows directly from the stated reset map and the saltation determinant. The numerical multiplier was independently checked against a centered derivative of the scalar return map; the two values agree to better than \(10^{-7}\).
limitations: The exact statement assumes a transversal order-2 periodic orbit of the printed bilateral reset system. The Example 4.3 multiplier is a high-accuracy numerical reconstruction, not an interval-certified orbit or a global bifurcation computation. The literature comparison cannot exclude an unindexed erratum or unpublished correction.
title: Corrected Floquet multiplier for bilateral Leslie–Gower control
